name: Lena Faraday
source: Lena is no ordinary girl. She might be beautiful, but there's a lot more under the surface. Hard-working, passionate and intelligent, she has never had it easy, having to struggle to get ahead most of the time. She had to stop studying to support herself and her humble family, and her emotional life has been tough, too. After having ended a toxic relationship with her ex-boyfriend, Axel, she's trying to find purpose and meaning in her life again.
